details: Contributed to an open-source project that makes scheduling tasks in PHP simpler and more reliable. Helped developers automate their workflows without the headache.

A fun, fast-paced puzzle game built with Vue.js where you strategically place blocks on a grid to clear them and rack up points. It's all about quick thinking and precision—try it out and see how high you can score!

A fully functional elevator simulator that brings buildings to life. Watch as the elevator responds intelligently to floor requests, animates smoothly through the shaft, and provides real-time feedback. A hands-on demo of complex state management with JavaScript.
A comprehensive travel planning tool that helps users craft the perfect itinerary. Build day-by-day plans, organize activities, and get recommendations to make every trip unforgettable.

Built a modern food ordering platform that makes it effortless for customers to browse menus, place orders, and track deliveries. Integrated secure payment processing and designed for restaurants, pubs, and delivery partners to scale their operations.
